title: wulfhilde backdrop
description: A backdrop of the wulfhilde engine, in a file ending .backdrop.json: an image of everything infinitely far away in every direction, with its own brightness, which skies show. The engine checks the same rules when it loads a backdrop, and more that a schema can't state: a key written twice, a number too near zero to read, and whether its image is there and is a PNG of at most 4,096 pixels on a side.

$schema.description: The schema that an editor checks the file against. The engine ignores it.

format.description: What the file is: a wulfhilde backdrop.

version.description: The version of the backdrop format the file is written in. This version of the engine reads version 1 only.

image.description: The asset path of the image, a PNG file ending .png under the content root, in /-separated segments of a-z, 0-9, _ and -, without the extension. It is read as a colour, in sRGB, whatever the PNG says. It is equirectangular, twice as wide as it is high: its centre column faces +X, moving left in it turns anticlockwise toward +Y, and its top row is straight up.

nits.description: The luminance of white, in nits, unless a sky gives its own.
